107 /**
108  * Severity of one campaign for the raise queue. Input is a strip projection
109  * (rank.mjs shape) optionally enriched with:
110  *   packet_ready       — a Decision Packet is gathered/cached for it
111  *   waiting_steps      — count of waiting(_on_john) Roadmap steps
112  *   capacity_conflict  — this campaign needs a capacity override to proceed
113  * @param {object} item enriched projection
114  * @returns {{ tier: number, tier_name: string, reasons: string[] }}
115  */
116 export function raiseSeverity(item = {}) {
117   const reasons = [];
118   const humanWait = nonEmpty(item.human_wait) && item.human_wait !== 'none';
119   const waitingSteps =
120     typeof item.waiting_steps === 'number' ? item.waiting_steps : 0;
121   const age =
122     typeof item.anti_starvation_age_days === 'number'
123       ? item.anti_starvation_age_days
124       : 0;
125 
126   if (humanWait && item.packet_ready === true) {
127     reasons.push('human_wait_with_packet_ready');
128     return { tier: RAISE_SEVERITY_TIERS.human_wait_packet_ready, tier_name: 'human_wait_packet_ready', reasons };
129   }
130   if (humanWait || waitingSteps > 0) {
131     if (humanWait) reasons.push(`human_wait=${item.human_wait}`);
132     if (waitingSteps > 0) reasons.push(`waiting_on_john_steps=${waitingSteps}`);
133     return { tier: RAISE_SEVERITY_TIERS.waiting_on_john_step, tier_name: 'waiting_on_john_step', reasons };
134   }
135   if (age > 0) {
136     reasons.push(`anti_starvation_age_days=${age}`);
137     return { tier: RAISE_SEVERITY_TIERS.anti_starvation, tier_name: 'anti_starvation', reasons };
138   }
139   if (item.capacity_conflict === true) {
140     reasons.push('capacity_conflict_needs_override');
141     return { tier: RAISE_SEVERITY_TIERS.capacity_conflict, tier_name: 'capacity_conflict', reasons };
142   }
143   reasons.push('ambient');
144   return { tier: RAISE_SEVERITY_TIERS.ambient, tier_name: 'ambient', reasons };
145 }
146 
147 /**
148  * Build the raise queue from enriched projections. One raised at a time;
149  * the queue length drives the ⚑ badge — the ONLY ambient signal (S0-E2).
150  *
151  * Age bump (R2 §4.5): a campaign with human_wait or waiting_on_john that is
152  * not currently raised and has starved ≥ T days MUST enter the queue even at
153  * lower severity — the starve counter cannot be silently absorbed.
154  * @param {object[]} items enriched projections
155  * @param {{ starve_threshold_days?: number }} [opts]
156  */
157 export function buildRaiseQueue(items = [], opts = {}) {
158   const threshold =
159     typeof opts.starve_threshold_days === 'number'
160       ? opts.starve_threshold_days
161       : STARVE_THRESHOLD_DAYS_DEFAULT;
162 
163   const scored = (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []).map((item) => {
164     const severity = raiseSeverity(item);
165     const age =
166       typeof item.anti_starvation_age_days === 'number'
167         ? item.anti_starvation_age_days
168         : 0;
169     const humanish =
170       (nonEmpty(item.human_wait) && item.human_wait !== 'none') ||
171       (typeof item.waiting_steps === 'number' && item.waiting_steps > 0);
172     const age_bumped = humanish && age >= threshold;
173     if (age_bumped) severity.reasons.push(`age_bump>=${threshold}d`);
174     return { ...item, severity, age_bumped };
175   });
176 
177   // Queue membership: anything below ambient severity, plus age-bumped
178   // campaigns that must enter regardless of tier.
179   const queue = scored
180     .filter(
181       (s) => s.severity.tier < RAISE_SEVERITY_TIERS.ambient || s.age_bumped,
182     )
183     .sort((a, b) => {
184       if (a.severity.tier !== b.severity.tier) return a.severity.tier - b.severity.tier;
185       const ageA = a.anti_starvation_age_days ?? 0;
186       const ageB = b.anti_starvation_age_days ?? 0;
187       if (ageB !== ageA) return ageB - ageA; // older first among equals
188       return String(a.project_id ?? a.project_path ?? '').localeCompare(
189         String(b.project_id ?? b.project_path ?? ''),
190       );
191     });
192 
193   return {
194     queue,
195     raised: queue[0] ?? null,
196     queue_length: queue.length,
197     max_raised: MAX_RAISED_BLOCKS,
198     badge: {
199       glyph: '⚑',
200       count: queue.length,
201       only_ambient_signal: true,
202       law: '⚑ count equals raise queue length; no other ambient notification surfaces anywhere in Anchor',
203     },
204     starve_threshold_days: threshold,
205   };
206 }

268 /**
269  * The SINGLE raised attention block. Time estimate is honest — shown only
270  * when the record carries one, never invented.
271  * @param {object} raiseQueue buildRaiseQueue result
272  */
273 export function buildRaiseBlock(raiseQueue = {}) {
274   const raised = raiseQueue.raised ?? null;
275   if (!raised) {
276     return {
277       block: 'raise',
278       present: false,
279       at_most_one: true,
280       voice: "Nothing needs you right now — every project is either running quietly or parked. I'll bring you the next decision as soon as it's ready.",
281       actions: [],
282       queue_note: null,
283     };
284   }
285   const behind = Math.max(0, (raiseQueue.queue_length ?? 1) - 1);
286   const summary = nonEmpty(raised.human_wait) && raised.human_wait !== 'none'
287     ? raised.human_wait
288     : nonEmpty(raised.next_recommended)
289       ? raised.next_recommended
290       : UNKNOWN_ANSWER;
291 
292   // ANSWER THE QUESTION BEFORE HE ASKS IT (John, 2026-08-06). The High Seat used to say
293   // only "this one needs input" — so he had to open the project and ask what it had
294   // done and what it would do next. Both facts are already on the projection; leading
295   // with them is the difference between a nag and a briefing.
296   const did = nonEmpty(raised.last_done) ? raised.last_done
297     : nonEmpty(raised.active_effort) ? raised.active_effort
298       : null;
299   const next = nonEmpty(raised.next_recommended) ? raised.next_recommended : null;
300 
301   return {
302     block: 'raise',
303     present: true,
304     at_most_one: true,
305     heading: '⚑ This one needs a decision from you',
306     project_id: raised.project_id ?? null,
307     project_path: raised.project_path ?? null,
308     /** The commissioned session that asked — so "bring it up" can open IT. */
309     session_id: raised.session_id ?? null,
310     summary,
311     /** What it has done — so he does not have to go in and ask. */
312     did,
313     /** What it would do next — so he can approve rather than investigate. */
314     next,
315     briefing: [
316       did ? `Done: ${did}` : null,
317       `Waiting on you: ${summary}`,
318       next ? `Next if you say go: ${next}` : null,
319     ].filter(Boolean),
320     time_estimate: nonEmpty(raised.time_estimate) ? raised.time_estimate : null,
321     severity: raised.severity,
322     actions: [
323       { act: 'bring_it_up', label: 'Bring it up', primary: true },
324       { act: 'later_today', label: 'Later today' },
325       { act: 'tomorrow', label: 'Tomorrow' },
326     ],
327     queue_note: `opens the full decision summary · ${behind} more waiting behind it, one at a time`,
328   };
329 }

335 /**
336  * Exactly ONE state pill for a tile. Raised campaign shows the ⚑ line; a
337  * running one shows its quiet line; parked-aging names its age; everything
338  * else is quiet. Unknown stays spoken (capacity honesty), never a meter.
339  * @param {object} item enriched projection
340  * @param {object|null} raised the currently raised item
341  */
342 export function tileStatePill(item = {}, raised = null) {
343   const isRaised =
344     raised != null &&
345     (raised.project_id ?? raised.project_path) ===
346       (item.project_id ?? item.project_path);
347   if (isRaised) {
348     const wait = nonEmpty(item.human_wait) && item.human_wait !== 'none'
349       ? item.human_wait
350       : 'a decision';
351     return { pill: `⚑ waiting on you · ${wait}`, kind: 'raised', quiet: false };
352   }
353   if ((item.anti_starvation_age_days ?? 0) > 0) {
354     return {
355       pill: `parked ${item.anti_starvation_age_days}d · I'll flag it if it sits much longer`,
356       kind: 'parked_aging',
357       quiet: true,
358     };
359   }
360   if (nonEmpty(item.active_effort)) {
361     return {
362       pill: `running quietly · ${item.active_effort}`,
363       kind: 'running_quietly',
364       quiet: true,
365     };
366   }
367   if (item.capacity === 'unknown') {
368     return {
369       pill: "quiet · I don't know how much capacity is free",
370       kind: 'quiet',
371       quiet: true,
372     };
373   }
374   return { pill: 'quiet · nothing needs you', kind: 'quiet', quiet: true };
375 }
376 
377 /**
378  * Project tiles: seal mini-icon + name + goal-in-a-phrase + exactly one
379  * state pill. Quiet tiles are dimmed. NO master data table (S2-N1).
380  * @param {object[]} items enriched projections
381  * @param {object|null} raised
382  */
383 export function buildProjectTiles(items = [], raised = null) {
384   const tiles = (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []).map((item) => {
385     const state = tileStatePill(item, raised);
386     return {
387       icon: 'assets/icons/ecgberht-project-seal.jpg',
388       name: item.project_id ?? item.project_path ?? 'unnamed campaign',
389       // The resolved path rides the tile so the HOST can map it to its own
390       // project id (2026-08-07, John: click a High Seat row → straight into
391       // that project's steward). Path-passport pattern — never the host id.
392       project_path: item.project_path ?? null,
393       goal_phrase: nonEmpty(item.goal_phrase)
394         ? item.goal_phrase
395         : nonEmpty(item.active_effort)
396           ? item.active_effort
397           : UNKNOWN_ANSWER,
398       state_pill: state.pill,
399       state_kind: state.kind,
400       state_line_count: 1,
401       dimmed: state.quiet,
402     };
403   });
404   return {
405     tiles,
406     master_data_table: false,
407     one_state_line_each: tiles.every((t) => t.state_line_count === 1),
408   };
409 }

415 /**
416  * The capacity & focus conversation card. Steward voice; named seat loads;
417  * ordered recommendation WITH reasons; override path. Capacity is spoken as
418  * known|unknown ONLY — no %-meters, no token gauges, ever (A3). Unknown
419  * capacity blocks FULL admits without an override receipt (A3 hard-stop).
420  * @param {{
421  *   items?: object[], demands?: {project_id: string, wants: string}[],
422  *   prefs?: object, env?: object, prefsPath?: string|null,
423  *   recommendation?: { order: string[], reasons: string[] }|null,
424  * }} [opts]
425  */
426 export function buildBalancingCard(opts = {}) {
427   const items = Array.isArray(opts.items) ? opts.items : [];
428   const demands = Array.isArray(opts.demands) ? opts.demands : [];
429   const seats = titlebarSeatOptions({
430     prefs: opts.prefs,
431     env: opts.env,
432     prefsPath: opts.prefsPath,
433   });
434 
435   const seat_loads = (seats.options ?? []).map((o) => ({
436     seat: o.family,
437     selected: o.selected === true,
438     // Honest load: named demands only — never a % remaining figure (A3).
439     demanded_by: demands
440       .filter((d) => d.seat === o.family || d.seat == null)
441       .map((d) => d.project_id),
442   }));
443 
444   const unknownCapacity = items
445     .filter((i) => i.capacity !== 'known')
446     .map((i) => i.project_id ?? i.project_path);
447 
448   // Deterministic default recommendation when none injected: FULL demanders
449   // in queue order, human-wait first — with the reasons spelled out.
450   let recommendation = opts.recommendation ?? null;
451   if (!recommendation) {
452     const order = demands.map((d) => d.project_id);
453     recommendation = {
454       order,
455       reasons: order.length
456         ? [
457             'ordered by how urgent each one is, then by how long it has waited',
458             'only a few big runs can go at once',
459             "anything that doesn't fit goes to parked ideas — nothing is dropped silently",
460           ]
461         : ['no big runs are queued — nothing to balance right now'],
462     };
463   }
464 
465   const voice = demands.length
466     ? `${demands.length} project${demands.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} want${demands.length === 1 ? 's' : ''} a big run, and there is not room for all of them at once. I suggest: ${recommendation.order.join(', then ')}. Say the word and I will keep that order — or change it, and I will record who changed it and why.`
467     : "Nothing is competing for capacity right now. When big runs collide I'll suggest an order and tell you why.";
468 
469   return {
470     card: 'capacity_and_focus',
471     steward_voice: voice,
472     seat_loads,
473     capacity_values_allowed: ['known', 'unknown'],
474     capacity_unknown: unknownCapacity,
475     full_admit_blocked_without_override: unknownCapacity.length > 0,
476     recommendation: {
477       order: recommendation.order,
478       reasons: recommendation.reasons,
479       has_reasons: recommendation.reasons.length > 0,
480     },
481     actions: [
482       { act: 'do_that', label: 'Do that', primary: true },
483       { act: 'reorder', label: 'Reorder…', lands_as: 'override_receipt' },
484       { act: 'why_reasoning', label: 'Why this order?' },
485     ],
486     override_law: 'override = receipt (who/when/why/from→to) — A1 human-override row',
487     mechanics_stamp:
488       'your choice always wins · every change is recorded with who and why · no made-up progress meters',
489     fake_meters: false,
490     percent_meter: false,
491     token_gauge: false,
492   };
493 }
494 
495 /**
496  * Apply a balancing override: John's reorder/force lands as a structured
497  * override receipt (who/when/why/from→to — A1/A3), validated against the
498  * locked receipt schema. Monologue never lands.
499  * @param {{ who: string, why: string, from: string, to: string, when?: string }} fields
500  */
501 export function applyBalancingOverride(fields = {}) {
502   const receipt = buildOverrideReceipt(fields);
503   const validated = validateReceipt(receipt);
504   if (!validated.ok) {
505     return { ...validated, applied: false };
506   }
507   return {
508     ok: true,
509     applied: true,
510     receipt: validated.receipt,
511     law: 'human override wins (A1) — but only as a receipt, never a silent reorder',
512   };
513 }

552 /**
553  * "Bring it up": hop to the project chamber INSIDE the same overlay (no
554  * second window) and open the Decision Packet with ZERO further gathering.
555  *
556  * Passport = Option P (annex A2): the resolved project path is the identity;
557  * the hop must land on the same strip/Face the project Seal opens. Packet
558  * source order: fresh brief cache (precomputed projection) → live Phase A
559  * assembly (still deterministic, zero model calls). The packet handed to the
560  * view is complete BEFORE the view renders — assemblePacketView gathers
561  * nothing.
562  * @param {{
563  *   project_path: string, surfaces?: object, packet?: object,
564  *   artifact?: object|null, question?: string|null, step?: string|null,
565  *   cache?: object|null,
566  * }} opts
567  */
568 export function bringItUp(opts = {}) {
569   if (!nonEmpty(opts.project_path)) {
570     return { ok: false, error: 'missing_project_path', spelling: SPELLING };
571   }
572   const resolved = path.resolve(opts.project_path);
573 
574   const passport = {
575     option: 'P',
576     scheme: 'path_passport',
577     project_path: resolved,
578     law: 'high-seat expand and project seal open must resolve the same realpath → same strip/Face (annex A2)',
579   };
580 
581   // Packet: injected → cached (fresh) → live Phase A. All deterministic.
582   let packet = opts.packet ?? null;
583   let from_cache = false;
584   if (!packet) {
585     const cached = opts.cache !== undefined
586       ? { exists: opts.cache != null, cache: opts.cache }
587       : loadBriefCache(resolved);
588     if (cached.exists) {
589       const surfaces = opts.surfaces ?? loadProjectSurfaces(resolved);
590       // A3: content-anchored stale check needs face + roadmap, not strip counts alone.
591       // Only include `roadmap` when the caller injected it or a live file exists.
592       // Omitting the key (vs passing null) avoids a false-stale when inject mode
593       // hands surfaces + cache without a roadmap file on disk — strip/face still
594       // gate freshness; A3 mutation detection runs whenever a live roadmap is present.
595       const live = {
596         strip: surfaces?.strip ?? null,
597         face: surfaces?.face ?? null,
598       };
599       if (opts.roadmap !== undefined) {
600         live.roadmap = opts.roadmap;
601       } else {
602         const loaded = loadProjectRoadmap(resolved);
603         if (loaded.ok && loaded.exists) {
604           live.roadmap = loaded.roadmap;
605         }
606       }
607       const staleness = briefCacheStale(cached.cache, live);
608       if (!staleness.stale) {
609         packet = cached.cache.packet;
610         from_cache = true;
611       }
612     }
613   }
614   if (!packet) {
615     packet = assembleBriefPacket({
616       project: resolved,
617       roots: [],
618       altitude: 'project',
619       ...(opts.surfaces !== undefined ? { surfaces: opts.surfaces } : {}),
620       ...(opts.roadmap !== undefined ? { roadmap: opts.roadmap } : {}),
621       ...(opts.journal !== undefined ? { journal: opts.journal } : {}),
622       ...(opts.anchor_knowledge !== undefined
623         ? { anchor_knowledge: opts.anchor_knowledge }
624         : {}),
625     });
626   }
627 
628   const packet_view = assemblePacketView(packet, {
629     project_id: opts.project_id ?? packet?.goal_card?.project_id ?? null,
630     step: opts.step ?? null,
631     question: opts.question ?? null,
632     artifact: opts.artifact ?? null,
633     from_cache,
634   });
635 
636   // THE CONVERSATION RECORD (2026-08-05). "Bring it up" is the altitude hop that drops
637   // John back into a project — so it is the right place for him to see how the plan got
638   // here, not just what it currently is. Read-only and NON-AUTHORITATIVE: this summary
639   // derives no status, no step and no next action; project state above still comes from
640   // the packet (Face + roadmap + Strip), and the ledger always wins.
641   const conversation = opts.conversation ?? summarizeConversation(resolved, { recent: 3 });
642 
643   return {
644     ok: true,
645     hop: {
646       in_overlay: true,
647       separate_window: false,
648       altitude: 'project',
649       returns_via: 'esc_or_breadcrumb',
650       passport,
651     },
652     packet,
653     packet_view,
654     conversation,
655     further_gathering: false,
656     from_cache,
657   };
658 }
659 
660 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
661 // Close overlay — ledger gains a seen receipt at most (S0 falsify)
662 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
663 
664 /**
665  * Close the High Seat overlay. The ledger gains AT MOST a seen receipt
666  * (altitude=portfolio) — nothing else; panel state evaporates (no dual
667  * store, dialogue ephemeral). Returns the receipt for the caller to append
668  * through the closed strip writer if mark_seen is requested.
669  * @param {{ mark_seen?: boolean, who?: string, when?: string }} [opts]
670  */
671 export function closeHighSeat(opts = {}) {
672   const receipt = opts.mark_seen === true
673     ? buildSeenReceipt({
674         who: opts.who ?? 'john',
675         when: opts.when,
676         altitude: 'portfolio',
677       })
678     : null;
679   return {
680     ok: true,
681     closed: true,
682     ledger_delta: receipt ? ['seen'] : [],
683     seen_receipt: receipt,
684     dual_store: false,
685     panel_state_persisted: false,
686     dialogue_persisted: false,
687   };
688 }
689 
690 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
691 // Assembly
692 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
693 
694 /**
695  * Enrich rank projections for the raise queue: packet readiness comes from
696  * the brief cache on disk (or injected). RAISE TIER 2 REVIVED (Wave 16):
697  * waiting_steps DERIVED from the EXISTING buildRoadmapProjection step statuses
698  * when not already supplied, so raiseSeverity → waiting_on_john_step fires.
699  *
700  * @param {object[]} ranked rankPortfolioStripFirst().ranked
701  * @param {{
702  *   enrich?: (item: object) => object,
703  *   derive_waiting?: boolean,
704  * }} [opts]
705  */
706 export function enrichForRaise(ranked = [], opts = {}) {
707   const enrich = typeof opts.enrich === 'function' ? opts.enrich : null;
708   const deriveWaiting = opts.derive_waiting !== false;
709   return (Array.isArray(ranked) ? ranked : []).map((r) => {
710     let waiting_steps =
711       typeof r.waiting_steps === 'number' ? r.waiting_steps : 0;
712     // Revive tier 2: derive from buildRoadmapProjection when unset / zero and
713     // a project path (or injected projection) is available.
714     if (
715       deriveWaiting &&
716       waiting_steps === 0 &&
717       (r.project_path || Array.isArray(r.roadmap_projection) || Array.isArray(r.projection))
718     ) {
719       if (Array.isArray(r.roadmap_projection) || Array.isArray(r.projection)) {
720         waiting_steps = countWaitingOnJohnSteps(
721           r.roadmap_projection ?? r.projection,
722         );
723       } else if (r.project_path) {
724         const derived = deriveWaitingSteps({ projectPath: r.project_path });
725         waiting_steps = derived.waiting_steps;
726       }
727     }
728     const base = {
729       ...r,
730       packet_ready:
731         r.packet_ready === true ||
732         (r.project_path ? loadBriefCache(r.project_path).exists : false),
733       waiting_steps,
734       capacity_conflict: r.capacity_conflict === true,
735     };
736     return enrich ? { ...base, ...enrich(base) } : base;
737   });
738 }
739 
740 /**
741  * Assemble the whole Screen 2 High Seat view model. Same injectable option
742  * surface as verbStatus (roots, env, prefs, surfaces …) — composition over
743  * the closed read bodies; zero write authority.
744  * @param {{
745  *   roots?: string[], items?: object[], status?: object,
746  *   demands?: object[], recommendation?: object|null,
747  *   prefs?: object, env?: object, prefsPath?: string|null,
748  *   starve_threshold_days?: number, enrich?: (item: object) => object,
749  * }} [opts]
750  * @returns {object} high seat view model
751  */
752 export function assembleHighSeat(opts = {}) {
753   let items;
754   if (Array.isArray(opts.items)) {
755     items = opts.items;
756   } else if (opts.status != null) {
757     // Injected portfolio status (tests / explicit rank shape) — still no walk
758     // when the caller already resolved projections.
759     items = enrichForRaise(opts.status?.portfolio?.ranked ?? [], {
760       enrich: opts.enrich,
761     });
762   } else if (opts.allow_legacy_status_walk === true) {
763     // Explicit opt-in only. Wave 17 retires the ambient badge/high-seat walk;
764     // production paths use assemblePortfolioGlance / buildBadgeFromIndex.
765     const status = verbStatus({
766       roots: Array.isArray(opts.roots) ? opts.roots : [],
767       env: opts.env,
768       envValue: opts.envValue ?? null,
769     });
770     items = enrichForRaise(status?.portfolio?.ranked ?? [], {
771       enrich: opts.enrich,
772     });
773   } else {
774     // Wave 17 default: no discoverStrips walk. Empty items when the caller
775     // did not supply projections / glance fold (bridge passes glance.items).
776     items = [];
777   }
778 
779   const raiseQueue = buildRaiseQueue(items, {
780     starve_threshold_days: opts.starve_threshold_days,
781   });
782   const raise_block = buildRaiseBlock(raiseQueue);
783   const tiles = buildProjectTiles(items, raiseQueue.raised);
784   const balancing = buildBalancingCard({
785     items,
786     demands: opts.demands ?? [],
787     recommendation: opts.recommendation ?? null,
788     prefs: opts.prefs,
789     env: opts.env,
790     prefsPath: opts.prefsPath,
791   });
792 
793   return {
794     schema: HIGH_SEAT_SCHEMA_ID,
795     spelling: SPELLING,
796     screen: 'S2',
797     mount: HIGH_SEAT_MOUNT,
798     titlebar: buildHighSeatTitlebar({
799       items,
800       raiseQueue,
801       prefs: opts.prefs,
802       env: opts.env,
803       prefsPath: opts.prefsPath,
804     }),
805     raise_block,
806     raised_block_count: raise_block.present ? 1 : 0,
807     // W15 — durability, as ONE banner above the campaigns rather than a warning per receipt.
808     // It sits outside the raise queue on purpose: the queue raises at most one campaign and
809     // durability is not a campaign, it is a fact about all of them at once. A project whose
810     // receipts have not been acknowledged is listed by name as 'state not yet committed',
811     // never folded into a tile pill where it would compete with the work itself.
812     durability: buildHighSeatDurability(opts),
813     raise_queue: {
814       queue_length: raiseQueue.queue_length,
815       raised_project: raiseQueue.raised?.project_id ?? null,
816       starve_threshold_days: raiseQueue.starve_threshold_days,
817     },
818     badge: raiseQueue.badge,
819     tiles,
820     // PORTFOLIO MEMORY (2026-08-05). Nothing anywhere recorded what the steward had
821     // actually been DOING across projects — history left with a folder when it moved.
822     // This is that record: efforts only (conversations held, scaffoldings proposed and
823     // confirmed, questions raised), never project state. Project truth still comes from
824     // the tiles above, read live, so this can never contradict a project.
825     steward_efforts: opts.steward_efforts
826       ?? summarizePortfolioEfforts({ env: opts.env, recent: 5 }),
827     balancing,
828     // TW7 S4-E2 — unknown capacity is a spoken hard-stop chamber (exactly
829     // three honest options), never a silent FULL admit and never a meter.
830     capacity_unknown_chamber: balancing.full_admit_blocked_without_override
831       ? buildCapacityUnknownChamber({ projects: balancing.capacity_unknown })
832       : null,
833     saybox: buildHighSeatSaybox(),
834     footer_stamp: HIGH_SEAT_FOOTER_STAMP,
835     // S2-N1 — the High Seat carries none of the forbidden surfaces.
836     negative: {
837       master_data_table: false,
838       percent_meter: false,
839       token_gauge: false,
840       raised_blocks_max: MAX_RAISED_BLOCKS,
841     },
842     ambient: {
843       only_signal: 'badge',
844       badge_count_equals_queue_length:
845         raiseQueue.badge.count === raiseQueue.queue_length,
846     },
847     write_authority: 'none',
848   };
849 }
